run_generate_version: run the generate_version script to compute HIPLOT_PYPI and HIPLOT_NPM version strings for CI
run_version_from_circle_tag: run generate_version with CIRCLE_TAG set to use the tag as both python and npm version
run_version_from_git: run generate_version without CIRCLE_TAG to derive version from the last git tag and commit count
review_version_logic: review the generate_version script logic for computing release candidate versions from git metadata
refactor_version_script: refactor the generate_version script to support additional versioning strategies or output formats
